name: Zurgena (Spain)
description: Vertically divided blue and yellow in the proportions 1:2, the blue charged with a yellow castle.
history: Zurgena was authorised by the Junta de Andalucía in 1995 to adopt its symbols but did not do so until January 2007; the flag is rectangular of 1:2, divided vertically at a third from the staff, the smaller blue portion bearing a gold yellow castle and the fly gold yellow.
